entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to the UE to indicate that the authentication procedure has failed and that the UE shall abort all activities.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Specifies the type of security header applied to the message.

entities.name: Authentication reject message type
entities.description: Identifies the message as an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

entities.name: Authentication procedure failure
entities.description: Condition where the authentication procedure has failed, triggering the network to send the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

entities.name: UE shall abort all activities
entities.description: Behavior required from the UE upon receiving the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

relations.description: The AUTHENTICATION REJECT message includes the Protocol discriminator IE.
The AUTHENTICATION REJECT message includes the Security header type IE.
The AUTHENTICATION REJECT message includes the Message type IE.
Authentication procedure failure triggers the network to send the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.
Receipt of the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message establishes that the UE shall abort all activities.
